proof_text:
unfold ToArray ToArray_postcond
  have h_size : (ToArray (xs) h_precond).size = xs.length := by
    simp [ToArray]
    <;> rfl

  have h_congruence : ∀ (i : Nat), i < xs.length → (ToArray (xs) h_precond)[i]! = xs[i]! := by
    intro i h
    have h₂ : (ToArray (xs) h_precond)[i]! = xs[i]! := by
      simp [ToArray]
      <;> simp_all [List.get]
      <;> aesop
    exact h₂

  exact ⟨h_size, h_congruence⟩
